text: Out of the light stepped a goblin. A real person, with a knife on his hip and a notch in his ear. And he could talk. His first question was simple. Where am I?
Taeo babbled the answer. Unit four oh two, Mangwon-dong, Mapo-gu. Seoul. Earth.
The summon card had looked like a receipt. Taeo had expected a construct. Instead, there was someone standing in his flat.
It was two minutes to midnight. Taeo said he was just going to get some air, and edged toward the door.
The goblin told him to stand away from the door. Taeo apologised. The goblin asked, for what?
So Taeo did the only thing he could think of. He showed him how to push the door handle down, and opened it. You can go, he said. It was the only door he knew how to open.
The goblin walked out to the corridor rail and looked down at a city he had never seen.
Then he came back inside. Not tonight, he said.

He wanted to know what Taeo had done. Taeo explained that a window had opened in the air, and he had pressed its draw button. Why? Because he wanted to see what would happen. He hadn't known it would be someone.
Taeo admitted he didn't know how to send him back. The goblin's answer was flat. Then find out.
Taeo tried. He said draw. He said menu. He even said please. Nothing happened.
He promised he would find out how. And he called the goblin by name. Nib.
Nib asked who had given him that name. Taeo said a window had appeared beside him, reading: Nib, goblin scout. Nib asked for Taeo's name in return, and repeated it once. Taeo.
Taeo offered him water. Nib was suspicious of water that came out of the wall, and told him to put the mug on the floor.
Then Nib said two words that would matter more than either of them knew. You first.
So Taeo drank first, to prove it was safe. Still alive, he reported. Only then did Nib drink.
Taeo's phone buzzed. He said it was just a message. Nib decided it was a shouting brick.
Taeo apologised for bringing him here. Nib said, you still did. Taeo knew.
Then Nib told him something strange. When he came out of the light, Taeo had said stay. Taeo had thought summons only followed commands, like Bae's golem. Carry, follow, stop.
Nib said, I'm not that one. And Taeo agreed. No. You're not.
Taeo offered him the bed. Nib refused. Taeo would sleep up there, and Nib would keep watch.
A message from Eunchae said the eggs had survived. Taeo hadn't told her about Nib.
He meant to stay awake too, just in case. By three in the morning, he was asleep.
In the dark, Nib whispered a name. Kett. Kett would find his watch post empty. And Kett would go looking for him.
In the morning, Nib woke Taeo up. Your brick is shouting.
It was an official notice. An unregistered summoning had been detected at his address. Taeo read it out. It said he had three days.
